<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a body part that can be extracted from a corpse at the [[preparation place|autopsy table]]. Upon removal, it has no effect on the corpse, unlike every other body part. In addition, similar to most other anatomy and theology items, it can be studied at the [[Study table]] for a {{Techpoint|Blue}} reward. For more information, see [[corpses]].
